theme_archetype.description: A highly functional, modern, and trustworthy mobile application. Leverages sleek glassmorphism to feel native to iOS, anchored by a deep Royal Blue for authority and Mint Green for positive actions.

buttons.primary: Background: Royal Blue, Text: Inverse (White), Radius: Pill (999px), Min-Height: 56px. Hover/Active opacity 0.8.
buttons.accent: Background: Mint Green, Text: Primary (#0F172A), Radius: Pill, Min-Height: 56px.
buttons.glass: Background: rgba(255,255,255,0.7), Blur: 10, Border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5), Radius: 24px

inputs.style: Background: White, Border: 1px solid #E2E8F0, Radius: 16px, Padding: 16px, Min-Height: 56px.

bottom_sheet.style: Background: Glass/White, Blur: 20 (expo-blur), Radius: 32px 32px 0 0, Padding: 24px, Shadow: soft
bottom_sheet.handle: Width: 40px, Height: 4px, Background: #CBD5E1, Radius: Pill, Align: Center, Margin-Top: 8px

cards.style: Background: White, Radius: 24px, Padding: 20px, Border: 1px solid #E2E8F0, Shadow: soft

onboarding_login.components: Hero image/Lottie, H1 Heading, Subtitle, Phone Number Input, OTP Input (4/6 boxes), Royal Blue Primary CTA.

home_booking.layout: Map background (Mocked), Bottom Sheet (Glassmorphism) over the map.
home_booking.features: Point-to-Point, Hourly, Schedule Tabs. Owner-driver toggle switch (Mint Green active state). Address input fields with subtle shadow.

fare_estimation.components: Vehicle type list, Price breakdown showing 10% discount in Mint Green, Payment selector (Cash/Card/UPI), 30% advance toggle, 'Confirm Ride' CTA.

live_tracking_driver.layout: Map background + Floating Glass Header (Trip Code) + Bottom Sheet (Driver Info)
live_tracking_driver.components: Trip Code Handshake display (e.g. 'Start Code: 4812'). Driver Details card: Avatar, Name, Rating (★), Aadhaar verification badge. Action row: Call/Chat buttons.

profile_garage.layout: Standard White background with Gray tint.
profile_garage.components: User Info Header. 'My Garage' section: List of cars (Make/Model/Transmission), 'Add Car' floating action button.

trip_history.components: Past trips cards. Date, Route (A to B), Fare, 'Download Invoice' outline button.

technical_rules.styling: StyleSheet API or NativeWind (if configured), no raw CSS.
technical_rules.accessibility: Touch targets must be >= 44x44. Uses accessible labels.
technical_rules.testing: All interactive elements MUST have `testID` attribute (React Native equivalent of data-testid). Example: `testID="login-submit-button"`

map_mock.description: Clean city street map background for live tracking mock

driver_avatar.description: Professional driver portrait for driver info card

car_profile.description: Modern sedan car profile for garage section
